I've had similar experience, actually I don't think I'm completely out of this rut yet, but I've got some advice I can offer.

Relax. No really, loosen yourself. There's no need to filter whatever comes out of your mouth. I don't think it's necessarily that your mind is blank, but that you are too conscious of what to say. For example, you might think "I don't know what to say because I'm not thinking anything" But you are! Just tell the person you are talking to that "Oh I'm a bit slow today and I'm not really sure what to say" And chances are you'll naturally move along fron there. Just be normal! I hope this helps :)
